objective: Broad text capability improvement, measured against smaller, similar and larger models; universal superiority is unproven
mixture_unit: prediction tokens after filtering, global deduplication, split assignment and tokenization

fineweb_edu.subset: fresh admitted documents plus explicitly measured replay

finepdfs_edu.subset: eng_Latn; page language and extraction checks

code.content_rehydration: Software Heritage public S3; raw SHA1 must equal blob_id

synthetic.scope: No synthetic examples enter this separate screen. Original source investigation remains deferred.

multilingual.claim: coverage probe only; not all-language competence

quality_substrata.math: start with short complete explanations; cap repeated numeric templates; no blanket removal of elementary math
quality_substrata.pdf: segment by page/section, retain complete text across blocks, do not head-truncate entire documents
quality_substrata.synthetic: group by originating prompt and source document before split; factual checks required
quality_substrata.web: education score is a feature, not a factual correctness guarantee

screen.learning_rate_policy: same LR and schedule across recipes; separate fixed-mixture 1e-4 versus 3e-4 bracket before confirmation
screen.purpose: triage harmful mixtures and discover directional signal; not a final quality claim

confirmation.recipes: top two F-series exploratory candidates plus F0, conditional on independent evidence

development.loss_objective: equal-domain mean of L_candidate/L_base minus 1, using the same tokenizer and token masks
development.confidence: paired bootstrap of independent document or problem families; simultaneous intervals for domain non-regression; two training seeds must agree in direction
development.additional_quality_evidence: held-out problem answer likelihood AND generated exact answers or sandboxed code correctness; short instructions and multilingual dev tasks
development.small_screen_inconclusive_action: extend confirmation budget or choose control; never label a noise-level winner optimal

promotion_requirements: all corpus sources revision-pinned and content available at training site
cross-source duplicate audit including old FineWeb train/val, aliases and synthetic parents
benchmarks reserved; evaluation contents never enter training documents
data and optimizer RNG state resume equivalence under the exact GPU topology
all source quotas measured after packing; no silent renormalization when a source exhausts
two-seed confirmation improves primary dev loss by at least 0.5 percent with paired interval excluding zero
every domain passes predeclared non-inferiority checks; mean gain cannot hide a large regression
correctness and instruction evaluation support the loss trend
same-recipe real-data rolling median MFU strictly greater than 0.50
disk headroom includes two complete optimizer checkpoints and next packed segment

long_run.advance_rule: next tranche only after multi-domain improvement and renewed capacity checks
long_run.repeat_experiment_above_cap: separate justified ablation; never infer universal four-epoch guarantee
long_run.candidate_curriculum: first 70 percent selected broad static mixture; next 20 percent gradually increase selected quality subsets; final 10 percent LR decay; static-versus-dynamic control required
long_run.context_extension: separate 2048 to 4096 pilot on repacked long documents before any 8192 attempt; measure retrieval and short-context retention

post_training.sft_loss_unit: assistant target tokens, with separate sample and total-context budgets reported
post_training.long_trace_truncation: reject or re-derive a complete short solution; do not cut off the answer or tool observation
stages: verifiable-reward pilot once base success exceeds zero
post_training.rl_empty_reward_policy: return to teaching data or easier problems; do not increase rollouts blindly

amendment.reason: User requested faster execution; unverified synthetic-parent identity is blocking every candidate in the original screen. Separate a non-synthetic screen from the later original synthetic-source comparison.
amendment.timing: No new-mixture training or candidate evaluation result has occurred. Amendment responds to data readiness, not observed candidate performance.
amendment.recipe_change: Transfer exactly the original synthetic 5 percentage points to the existing FineWeb-Edu replay component; control unchanged. Preserve each other top-level and within-source percentage.
amendment.original_synthetic_comparison: Deferred separate ablation; no equivalence or synthetic-quality claim.

resource_policy.cpu_checks: Run independent required checks concurrently; avoid duplicate tokenization and reuse bound normalization indexes.
resource_policy.screen_concurrency: The inherited maximum of two runs is an upper bound, subject to aggregate disk reservation, actual allocation and measured MFU.
resource_policy.additional_gpu_scaling: Increase independent run concurrency only after measured aggregate checkpoint/pack headroom is sufficient; do not increase world size or batch silently.
resource_policy.aggregate_storage_gate: Sum each concurrent writer peak (existing checkpoint plus atomic replacement), next packed segments and safety margin; per-process free-space checks alone are insufficient.
